summary: Rayman entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Rayman Origins

primary.why: Rayman Origins is a UbiArt Framework 2D platformer and the PC release gives the best capture/settings route while preserving the main HD-console content. Handheld versions are valid access routes but can have platform-specific presentation/control compromises.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release. Record storefront/build, controller, resolution, co-op setup, unlock/completion state, and whether Vita/3DS/console versions were compared.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record co-op setup, controller, and storefront/build.

entries.title: Rayman 2: The Great Escape
entries.definitive_edition: PC with fixes for capture, or Dreamcast for classic high-fidelity presentation; Rayman Revolution separately

emulation.emulator: Flycast/Demul for Dreamcast comparison; native PC for primary capture
emulation.notes: Document compatibility fixes or emulator settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Dreamcast presentation or fixed PC release depending on archive goal

primary.version: Dreamcast-quality route or current PC release with fixes
primary.why: Rayman 2 has many ports with meaningful differences. The Dreamcast route is often treated as the high-fidelity classic presentation, while PC is the most practical capture route if compatibility fixes are documented. The PS2 Rayman Revolution route is an expanded/reworked variant, not a simple replacement.
primary.how_to_play: Use the GOG/PC version with community fixes for capture, or Dreamcast hardware/emulation if prioritizing classic high-fidelity presentation. Record platform, version, controller, fixes, resolution, and whether Rayman Revolution was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Play separately only if documenting the reworked PS2 version.
secondary.why: Rayman Revolution changes structure enough to be a variant.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record exact platform and do not merge Rayman Revolution's changes into the base route.

entries.title: Rayman Legends
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC for capture; Wii U and Switch Definitive Edition as control/version comparisons

emulation.notes: Use native PC route; Cemu only if documenting Wii U GamePad behavior without hardware.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC at high resolution, with Wii U hardware for original-control fidelity

primary.why: Rayman Legends has many modern ports, and the PC release is the cleanest high-resolution capture route for the core game. The Wii U original has distinct GamePad/Murfy interaction, while the Switch Definitive Edition is a convenient later route rather than a simple replacement for every control style.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release for capture, and record storefront/build, controller, resolution, co-op setup, challenge access, and whether Wii U GamePad or Switch Definitive Edition differences were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Compare if preserving the original asymmetric control design.
secondary.why: Some interactions were designed around Wii U GamePad use.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if Switch access is the goal.
secondary.why: Convenient current-console route, but not the cleanest capture path.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record co-op setup, challenge access, controller, and whether Murfy/GamePad differences were compared.

entries.title: Rayman 3: Hoodlum Havoc
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC release with fixes documented; Rayman 3 HD separately if remaster coverage matters

emulation.notes: Use native PC route; console emulation only for branch comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Fixed PC release or original console hardware depending on route

primary.version: Current GOG/PC release with fixes documented
primary.why: Rayman 3 has multiple console and PC routes, and the PC version is the best capture/settings route if compatibility fixes and FMV/audio state are documented. Rayman 3 HD is a later console remaster route and should be compared separately.
primary.how_to_play: Use the GOG/PC release with community fixes. Record storefront/build, widescreen/fix state, controller, FMV/audio quality, language, score/completion state, and whether Rayman 3 HD or console versions were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting the HD remaster.
secondary.why: It is a later console remaster rather than the same PC capture route.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only for handheld branch coverage.
secondary.why: It is not the same game structure as the 3D versions.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record fix state, FMV/audio source, controller, score/completion, and HD-remaster comparison.

entries.title: Rayman
entries.definitive_edition: Rayman Forever / GOG PC release with patches documented, plus original-platform comparison if needed

emulation.emulator: DOSBox for PC; DuckStation/Mednafen for console comparisons
emulation.notes: Use GOG PC route for primary; document emulator/core and original media if comparing.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original platform hardware for each version; fixed PC route for current access

primary.version: Rayman Forever / current GOG PC release with patches documented
primary.why: The original Rayman has many versions with meaningful differences. The GOG Rayman Forever route is the easiest current PC access path and includes related PC content, but PlayStation/Saturn/Jaguar originals should be compared if the archive wants exact first-release audiovisual behavior.
primary.how_to_play: Use the GOG Rayman Forever PC release with community fixes. Record storefront/build, DOSBox or wrapper settings, Rayman Plus/DX patch state, controller, music/audio source, level/completion state, and whether PlayStation/Saturn/Jaguar versions were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting exact original release differences.
secondary.why: The PC Forever route is practical but not identical to every original version.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting those later access paths.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record DOSBox/wrapper, patch state, audio source, controller, and platform compared.

entries.title: Rayman Raving Rabbids

emulation.emulator: Dolphin optional if real Wii controllers/sensor setup is documented
emulation.notes: Original Wii hardware is preferred for motion-control fidelity.

primary.why: Rayman Raving Rabbids was designed around Wii motion-control minigames, so the Wii route best preserves the intended input and party-game structure. PC and HD-console routes are useful for capture/comparison but do not replace the motion-control design target.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Wii version on original hardware or a carefully documented Dolphin route with real controllers if needed. Record controller/sensor setup, region, minigame progress, score/medals, multiplayer state, and whether PC/Xbox 360/PS2/handheld branches were compared.

secondary.why: Wii is the intended-control primary route.
They are distinct from the Wii party-game route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record controller/sensor setup and do not merge handheld adaptations with the Wii route.
